classes.name: TopLoc_Datum3D
classes.summary: Describes a coordinate transformation, i.e. a change to an elementary 3D coordinate system, or position in 3D space. A Datum3D is always described relative to the default datum. The default datum is described relative to itself: its origin is (0,0,0), and its axes are (1,0,0) (0,1,0) (0,0,1).

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Constructs a Datum3D form a Trsf from gp. An error is raised if the Trsf is not a rigid transformation.

instanceMethods.name: Transformation
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a {@link gp_Trsf | `gp_Trsf`} which, when applied to this datum, produces the default datum.

instanceMethods.name: Trsf
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a {@link gp_Trsf | `gp_Trsf`} which, when applied to this datum, produces the default datum.

instanceMethods.name: Form
instanceMethods.comment: Return transformation form.

classes.name: TopLoc_ItemLocation
classes.summary:
An ItemLocation is an elementary coordinate system in a Location.
The ItemLocation contains:
- The elementary Datum.
- The exponent of the elementary Datum.
- The transformation associated to the composition.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Sets the elementary Datum to <D> Sets the exponent to.

classes.name: TopLoc_Location
classes.summary: A Location is a composite transition. It comprises a series of elementary reference coordinates, i.e. objects of type {@link TopLoc_Datum3D | `TopLoc_Datum3D`}, and the powers to which these objects are raised.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Constructs an empty local coordinate system object. Note: A Location constructed from a default datum is said to be "empty".

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Constructs the local coordinate system object defined by the transformation T. T invokes in turn, a {@link TopLoc_Datum3D | `TopLoc_Datum3D`} object.

instanceMethods.name: IsIdentity
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if this location is equal to the Identity transformation.

instanceMethods.name: Identity
instanceMethods.comment: Resets this location to the Identity transformation.

instanceMethods.name: FirstDatum
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the first elementary datum of the Location. Use the NextLocation function recursively to access the other data comprising this location. Exceptions Standard_NoSuchObject if this location is empty.

instanceMethods.name: FirstPower
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the power elevation of the first elementary datum. Exceptions Standard_NoSuchObject if this location is empty.

instanceMethods.name: NextLocation
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns a Location representing <me> without the first datum. We have the relation:
<me> = `NextLocation()` * `FirstDatum()` ^ `FirstPower()` Exceptions Standard_NoSuchObject if this location is empty.

instanceMethods.name: Transformation
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the transformation associated to the coordinate system.

instanceMethods.name: Inverted
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns the inverse of <me>.
<me> * `Inverted()` is an Identity.

instanceMethods.name: Multiplied
instanceMethods.comment: Returns <me> * <Other>, the elementary datums are concatenated.

instanceMethods.name: Divided
instanceMethods.comment: Returns <me> / <Other>.

instanceMethods.name: Predivided
instanceMethods.comment: Returns <Other>.`Inverted()` * <me>.

instanceMethods.name: Powered
instanceMethods.comment: Returns me at the power <pwr>. If <pwr> is zero returns Identity. <pwr> can be lower than zero (usual meaning for powers).

instanceMethods.name: HashCode
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns a hashed value for this local coordinate system. This value is used, with map tables, to store and retrieve the object easily.
@returns a computed hash code

instanceMethods.name: IsEqual
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if this location and the location Other have the same elementary data, i.e. contain the same series of {@link TopLoc_Datum3D | `TopLoc_Datum3D`} and respective powers. This method is an alias for operator ==.

instanceMethods.name: IsDifferent
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if this location and the location Other do not have the same elementary data, i.e. do not contain the same series of {@link TopLoc_Datum3D | `TopLoc_Datum3D`} and respective powers. This method is an alias for operator !=.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Clear myItems.

classes.name: TopLoc_SListOfItemLocation

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a list from an other one. The lists are shared.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a List with <anItem> as value and <aTail> as tail.

instanceMethods.name: Assign
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a list from an other one. The lists are shared. The list itself is returned.

instanceMethods.name: IsEmpty
instanceMethods.comment: Return true if this list is empty.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the list to be empty.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the current value of the list. An error is raised if the list is empty.

instanceMethods.name: Tail
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the current tail of the list. On an empty list the tail is the list itself.

instanceMethods.name: Construct
instanceMethods.comment: Replaces the list by a list with <anItem> as Value and the list <me> as tail.

instanceMethods.name: ToTail
instanceMethods.comment: Replaces the list <me> by its tail.

instanceMethods.name: More
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the iterator has a current value. This is !IsEmpty().

instanceMethods.name: Next
instanceMethods.comment: Moves the iterator to the next object in the list. If the iterator is empty it will stay empty. This is `ToTail()`.
